decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 with its own product page, its market value is still uncertain, and keeping a compact dumper that shares components with the existing range costs little, so the option stays open.
The articulated dumper fits the firm's construction vehicle line, and one year of market presence reveals too little to justify abandoning it.

The mine rescue vehicle builds on the firm's core underground expertise and serves a niche of task-specific customers where long sales cycles mean results resolve slowly, so the option is worth holding.
The compact telescopic loader is still early in its life cycle, its holding cost is low within a growing industry, and there is no negative evidence yet, so management keeps the option alive.
